comment: SHA-pinned index of BF16 reference dumps for the quant-quality eval. Each ref is content-addressed by sha256; producer_cmd + llamacpp_commit + slice_md5 are the reproduction recipe. See docs/plans/issue-113-quant-quality-eval.md §'Reference dump → HF Hub'.

qwen3.5-0.8b-bf16.kldref.bin.producer_cmd: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rocm-7.12/lib cargo run --release -p hipfire-runtime --example build_kld_ref --features deltanet -- --bf16-gguf /data/models/unsloth/Qwen3.5-0.8B/Qwen3.5-0.8B-BF16.gguf --slice benchmarks/quality-baselines/slice/wikitext2-1024s-2048ctx.txt --top-k 256 --output benchmarks/quality-baselines/refs/qwen3.5-0.8b-bf16.kldref.bin --llama-perplexity-bin /home/kread/git/llm/llama.cpp/build-strix/bin/llama-perplexity
qwen3.5-0.8b-bf16.kldref.bin.comment: 0.8B BF16 reference dump, 2026-05-11, ~16 min wall, 1238 reduced tok/s on gfx1151. Source GGUF pulled from unsloth (same lineage as 9B ref); local-only pending HF upload to hipfire-models/qwen-kldref.

qwen3.5-9b-bf16.kldref.bin.comment: 9B BF16 reference dump, 2026-05-08, ~53 min wall, 375 reduced tok/s. Uploaded to hipfire-models/qwen-kldref 2026-05-11.

qwen3.6-27b-bf16.kldref.bin.comment: 27B BF16 reference dump, 2026-05-09, 2h 3m wall, 162 reduced tok/s. Required --no-mmap flag (passed automatically by build_kld_ref) — without it, demand-paging on 50 GB BF16 weights caused eviction-cycle stall on 124 GB UMA. GGUF copied locally to /home/kread/models-local/ from NFS to reduce per-page-fault read time. VM (enertree) shut down to free working-set RAM. Uploaded to hipfire-models/qwen-kldref 2026-05-11.

qwen3.5-0.8b-f32-native-16chunk.kldref.b.comment: llama-free. Built by build_kld_ref_native from hipfire OWN F32 oracle forward, so the engine-port difference cancels and there is no ~0.30-0.36 nat cross-engine floor. NOT comparable to the llama-sourced bf16 refs in this manifest. 16-chunk subset: fine for A/B, thin for a published absolute number.
qwen3.5-0.8b-f32-native-16chunk.kldref.b.producer_cmd: cargo run --release -p hipfire-runtime --features deltanet --example build_kld_ref_native -- --model oracle-f32.hfq --slice benchmarks/quality-baselines/slice/wikitext2-1024s-2048ctx.txt --top-k 256 --n-ctx 2048 --max-chunks 16 --output benchmarks/quality-baselines/refs/qwen3.5-0.8b-f32-native-16chunk.kldref.bin
qwen3.5-0.8b-f32-native-16chunk.kldref.b.consumer_cmd: cargo run --release -p hipfire-runtime --features deltanet --example eval_hipfire -- --model <cand>.hfq --ref benchmarks/quality-baselines/refs/qwen3.5-0.8b-f32-native-16chunk.kldref.bin --kv-mode f32 --output <cand>.kldseq
